description: Read the latest messages (default 20, max 50) from the shared Slack channel pinned in your own client space, as plain text with author and time. Requires creator_spaces:read and membership in that client space; the channel always comes from the space's pin.

workspace_id.description: Client space workspace id from bamf.list_creator_spaces. Optional when you belong to exactly one space.

name: bamf.read_team_channel
